content: Le wen be xgab yilo wdizh beya
Rese gu wech nu bzan. Nanzhaalt zoblazh rese gu gak gu maestr xaa nlu xtizh Dios; nel rese nu, xaa nzaa kwent xtizh Dios, telisa mas gro kwent naab Dios lo nu.
Nu rese be nak xaa nzeb jwalt. Chelee tub xaa nzhedizh purse kwaan wen, xaa zee nak tub xaa nali nzo lo rese kwaan nle xaa, nu nle xaa gan nseli xaa dubse kwerp cheen xaa.
Nu ne be xomod nak kabay; ngoo be fren roo ma zee ya ma loka lad nzhekla be.
Nu seeka nak tub bark kwaan gro doo, nixa nze tub mbi dox nzobyaya, nu lee xaa kwaan nzhano bark nzhe xaaya kwaan tub le yag dik. Sbaa nzho mod nzhano xaa bark loka lad nzhekla xaa dubse leen nistoo.

Nu seeka nak luzh myet; leeya nak tub kwaan tik doo, per leezha leeya nzhedizh xaa, leeya nii duzna kwaan yiya. Nu kwaan nzhedizh xaa nak mod tik bal cheen ki, per nleya gan nzeka dubse tub yi gro doo.
Nu kwaan nii myet nak mod tub bal cheen ki kwaan nle yalki leen lextoo myet. Leeya nak kwaan nzek mod ki kwaan nze lo Maxuu, nu kwaan nlux dub lextoo myet.
Reta klas ma wen, re mbyin, nu re mball, nu re ma nzho leen nistoo nle myet gan nseed myet ma.
Per lee roo myet nak tub kwaan nik tub xaa zer le gan seed. Kwaanzee leeya nak tub kwaan tira nawent.
Kwaan roo be nzholl be lo Xuz be Dios, nu kwaan roo be nge be lo re wechxinn be, xaa mdexkwaa Dios kwentaxa nak Dios.
Rese gu wech nu bzan, nanzhaalt kwaan leeka roo be naab be kwaan wen nu naab be kwaan nawent gak lo wechxinn be. Kwaane si tira nawent nak.
Tub xlen pa nzhib nis, ¿che nzho mod zhib nis nax nu noka nis nzhig?
Rese gu wech nu bzan, ne gu nyent mod zaa tub yag ig tub xle kwaan nak olib; nu nyent mod zaa tub yag ub tub xle kwaan nak ig, sbaaka nixa nis nax nyent mod zhiba pa nzhib nis nzhig.
Yalnzhak kwaan wlipa
Nu chelee nzho lak xaa nzhak lo gu nla lak kwaan yek, nzhaal le xaa kwaan wen, nu gak xaa tub xaa nadoo, kwaane lu yalnzhak cheen xaa.
Per chelee be nzoblazh be, nu chelee be nzhekla be le be gan rese kwaan, zee telisa nanzhaalt to be yalxwa nu yé be wli nak kwaan nawlit.
Lee yalnzhak ne nanzet lo Dios, sinka lee yalnzhak ne nze naz lo yizhyo, nu cheen myet yizhyo naka; nanakta cheen Dios leeya nak cheen Maxuu.
Nu pa nzo xaa nzoblazh nu xaa nzhekla le gan kwent cheen nebse lee xaa, nu noka baa nanzhiwent re xaa nu le xaa rese kwaan nawent.
Per lee yalnzhak kwaan nze lo Dios nak nebse kwaan nzhul, nu nle zee kwi wen xaa; nu lee xaa nkano yalnzhak:

content.text: nu nzhekla xaa gon kwaan nii stub xaa,
nu nles lextoo xaa ne xaa wechxinn xaa,
nu nle xaa kwaan nali nak,
nu nangwiit xaa cho nak xaa,

content: Kwaanzee lee xaa le kwi wen re xaa, nak xaa mod tub xaa nxeen bizh wen, nu zee top xaa xleya, zee gaka mod xaa nali nzo.
